candela-laser.text: In looksmaxxing discussion "Candela laser" stands for a family of clinic lasers used for hair removal, pigment, redness and skin tightening, so users pick the device that matches their target concern. Evidence exists per device, not for the brand as a whole.

lumecca-ipl.text: Users look to Lumecca for fading sun spots, freckles and facial redness to get a more even complexion. It is an intense pulsed light device rather than a laser, and supporting studies are small, though IPL is an established category.

sciton-bbl-moxi-halo.text: BBL, Moxi and Halo are Sciton treatments people combine for sun damage, pigment, redness, texture and scars, aiming at a fresher, more even complexion. Supporting studies are small.

moxi-laser.text: Moxi is used by people seeking a lighter-downtime resurfacing option for pigmentation, sun damage and skin texture. Evidence for these appearance uses comes from small studies.

excel-v-laser.text: Users turn to Excel V to reduce facial redness, visible blood vessels and sun spots for a clearer, more even face. Supporting studies are small.

laser-genesis.text: Laser Genesis is promoted as a low-downtime facial treatment for tone, redness and fine texture. Published evidence for the appearance effect is very thin, mostly a small split-face trial.

vbeam-perfecta.text: Users seek Vbeam for facial redness, broken capillaries, rosacea-related flushing and some scars to get a calmer, more even complexion. It is well established for vascular lesions; evidence for purely cosmetic redness is thinner.

morpheus8-burst.text: Burst mode is the deeper setting of Morpheus8, promoted for skin laxity, texture and mild fat remodeling around the lower face and neck. Little independent evidence exists for this setting specifically.

morpheus8-body.text: Morpheus8 Body is used on the abdomen, arms and thighs for skin laxity and texture, for instance after weight loss. Evidence is limited to practice reports and one small registered study.

fractora-rf.text: Fractora is the RF pin handpiece that preceded Morpheus8, used for skin laxity, acne scars and oil control. It has been studied in small, mostly early studies.

chain: Firmer skin, softer wrinkles and scars
profound-rf.text: Profound is discussed as a hardmaxxing option for skin laxity, wrinkles and acne scarring. It is documented mainly in registered device studies.

secret-rf.text: Secret RF is used for skin quality and facial wrinkles through fractional microneedle radiofrequency. Two registered studies exist, with little else documented.

vivace-rf-microneedling.text: Vivace is an RF microneedling device people consider for skin tightening and texture, in line with the wider RF microneedling category. No study located names the Vivace device itself.

chain: Smoother skin, fewer scars and lines
potenza-rf.text: Potenza is used for wrinkles, fine lines, scars, stretch marks and pigmentation to improve skin quality. Evidence comes mainly from small registered studies.

sofwave.text: Sofwave is used for lifting the brow, neck and under-chin and softening fine lines, with minimal downtime. It is FDA-cleared, and a 2023 review describes clinically significant lift results across many registered trials.

ultherapy-prime.text: Ultherapy Prime is the updated Ultherapy system, used for non-surgical lifting of the lower face and neck with improved imaging. Evidence for the original Ultherapy is broader; the Prime model itself is early-stage.

ulthera-deepsee.text: DeepSEE is used for non-surgical tightening of the lower face and under-chin, with imaging that lets the operator see tissue layers. A trial is registered but results are not summarised in available sources.

doublo-hifu.text: Doublo is a Korean HIFU device used for facial and neck skin tightening. Two small published studies in Asian patients have examined it.

ultraformer-iii.text: Ultraformer III is a Korean HIFU device used for facial lifting and skin rejuvenation. Published studies are small and mostly cover the related Ultraformer MPT model.

thermage-flx.text: Thermage FLX is used for non-surgical tightening of the face, eye area and body. The Thermage line was the first monopolar RF skin-tightening system FDA-cleared, in 2002; evidence is many small studies and few controlled trials.

exilis-ultra-exilis-elite.text: Exilis is a BTL radiofrequency platform used on the face and body for non-surgical skin tightening. Little device-specific evidence appears in the sources reviewed.

chain: RF plus magnetic fields and suction
venus-legacy.text: Venus Legacy is used for skin laxity, wrinkles, cellulite and mild fat reduction on the face and body. Published evidence is thin.

venus-viva.text: Venus Viva is used for acne scars, wrinkles and general resurfacing with shorter recovery than ablative approaches. Support comes from small uncontrolled studies.

pelleve.text: Pellevé is used for wrinkle reduction and mild tightening, and followed Thermage as an RF option after 2002. Evidence comes from small uncontrolled studies.

bodytite.text: BodyTite is used to remove fat while tightening the overlying skin, aiming at a leaner contour with less loose skin than liposuction alone. The visible contour change is the result of the procedure; evidence is mostly surgeon-reported series.

accutite.text: AccuTite is used on the jowls and neck to reduce small fat deposits and tighten skin, for a more defined lower face with less downtime than a neck lift. Evidence is small studies and surgeon reviews.

vaser-liposuction.text: VASER is used for body contouring and abs "etching", where fat removal around muscle shows more definition. The change is visible once healed; evidence is mostly surgeon case series and a few small trials.

power-assisted-liposuction-pal.text: PAL is a motorized liposuction variant users consider for removing stubborn fat in a smoother, more precise way. The contour change is visible after healing; the claimed precision advantage has little head-to-head trial evidence.

water-assisted-liposuction-bodyjet.text: Water-assisted liposuction, including the BodyJet system, is used for fat removal and body contouring. The contour change is visible after healing; documentation is mainly for fat harvesting, with thinner contouring data.

chain: Dilute lidocaine numbs and swells fat
tumescent-liposuction.text: Tumescent liposuction is the standard technique for removing localized fat under local anesthesia, used on areas such as the abdomen, flanks, neck and jowls. The contour change is visible after healing; safety data come from large surgeon surveys.
